requirements.title: Vaccination procedure
requirements.sourceVersion: QCPP remote assessment portal — surveillance round, printed 20 Oct 2026
requirements.wording: Provide evidence of procedure that shows the delivery of pharmacy services which is related to vaccination.
requirements.summary: Upload the pharmacy's written vaccination procedure.

evidenceExamples.text: A written procedure covering vaccination service delivery.
Documentation of how vaccinations are delivered, including patient screening, consent, administration and after-care.

requirements.note: Imported from the October 2026 remote assessment portal for Burke Road Compounding Pharmacy; not a confirmed deficiency.

requirements.title: Beyond-use dates (complex compounding)
requirements.sourceVersion: QCPP remote assessment portal — surveillance round, printed 20 Oct 2026
requirements.wording: Provide evidence of how beyond use dates (BUD) are determined, assigned and recorded for compounded preparations.
requirements.summary: Upload the pharmacy's beyond-use dating protocol.

evidenceExamples.text: A written BUD protocol.
The protocol must include the stability data or other evidence used to derive the BUDs.
Reference to the applicable USP <795>/<797> limits or the All Pharmacy Formulary where those standards are used.

requirements.note: Imported from the October 2026 remote assessment portal for Burke Road Compounding Pharmacy; not a confirmed deficiency.

requirements.title: Self-audit or evaluation (last 6 months)
requirements.sourceVersion: QCPP remote assessment portal — surveillance round, printed 20 Oct 2026
requirements.wording: Provide evidence of up to 2 evaluations or self-audits which have been performed in the past 6 months.
requirements.summary: Upload up to two evaluations or self-audits performed in the last 6 months.

evidenceExamples.text: Evaluations or self-audits dated within the last 6 months.
Topics must cover some or all of: staged supply, dose administration aids, clinical interventions, active service review.

requirements.note: Imported from the October 2026 remote assessment portal for Burke Road Compounding Pharmacy; not a confirmed deficiency.

requirements.title: Pharmacist and owner registrations
requirements.sourceVersion: QCPP remote assessment portal — surveillance round, printed 20 Oct 2026
requirements.wording: Provide evidence of all owners and all registered pharmacists involved in the pharmacy who have a current Pharmacist registration with AHPRA.
requirements.summary: Upload AHPRA registration details for all registered pharmacists involved in the pharmacy.

evidenceExamples.text: A list of all owners and registered pharmacists at the pharmacy.
Each person's current AHPRA registration details (or a public-register extract).

requirements.note: Imported from the October 2026 remote assessment portal for Burke Road Compounding Pharmacy; not a confirmed deficiency.

requirements.title: Vaccine cold-chain self-audit (Strive for 5)
requirements.sourceVersion: QCPP remote assessment portal — surveillance round, printed 20 Oct 2026
requirements.wording: Provide evidence of a self-audit related to the storage of vaccines in the past 12 months. Guidance on self-audits is available in the Strive for 5 program resources.
requirements.summary: Upload the pharmacy's Strive for 5 self-audit performed in the last 12 months.

evidenceExamples.text: A completed vaccine storage self-audit dated within the last 12 months.
Temperature logs, fridge audit notes or photographs completed alongside the self-audit.

requirements.title: Insurance certificates
requirements.sourceVersion: QCPP remote assessment portal — surveillance round, printed 20 Oct 2026
requirements.wording: Provide details of insurance coverage: certificate of currency for professional indemnity and public liability, and work cover where it is legally required.
requirements.summary: Upload your current insurance certificates, including professional indemnity and public liability, and work cover if required.

evidenceExamples.text: Current certificate(s) of currency for professional indemnity and public liability insurance.
Workers compensation insurance certificate of currency.

requirements.title: Business continuity plan
requirements.sourceVersion: QCPP remote assessment portal — surveillance round, printed 20 Oct 2026
requirements.wording: Provide details of the pharmacy's business continuity plan, including how the pharmacy mitigates and responds to interruptions to services.
requirements.summary: Upload the pharmacy's business continuity plan.

evidenceExamples.text: A written business continuity plan.
The plan should address mitigation and responses to service interruptions (e.g. power loss, network outage, supply failure).

requirements.title: Position descriptions with S&Q responsibilities
requirements.sourceVersion: QCPP remote assessment portal — surveillance round, printed 20 Oct 2026
requirements.wording: Provide the pharmacy's position descriptions for all staff, including staff involved in governance, management and delivery of safety and quality activities.
requirements.summary: Upload the pharmacy's position descriptions for all staff, which include staff who are involved in the governance, management, and delivery of safety and quality activities.

evidenceExamples.text: Position descriptions for each role.
Descriptions must set out safety and quality responsibilities for each role.

requirements.title: IT loss recovery process
requirements.sourceVersion: QCPP remote assessment portal — surveillance round, printed 20 Oct 2026
requirements.wording: Provide evidence of the pharmacy's information technology (IT) loss/data recovery process. The record must be from the last 18 months.
requirements.summary: Upload the pharmacy's IT loss/data recovery process used within the last 18 months.

evidenceExamples.text: A written IT loss/data recovery process.
The record or exercise demonstrating the process was tested or used in the last 18 months.

requirements.title: Annual document review
requirements.sourceVersion: QCPP remote assessment portal — surveillance round, printed 20 Oct 2026

requirements.summary: Upload evidence of the pharmacy's document review system, including how it demonstrates annual review and communication.

Evidence showing documents are reviewed annually and communicated to all staff.

requirements.sourceVersion: QCPP remote assessment portal — surveillance round, printed 20 Oct 2026

evidenceExamples.text: A log or register of safety and quality issues.

requirements.title: Recruitment process and employment contract
requirements.sourceVersion: QCPP remote assessment portal — surveillance round, printed 20 Oct 2026
requirements.wording: Provide evidence of the pharmacy's recruitment process and a signed contract of employment for one current staff member. (Remove/censor any personal details not needed.)
requirements.summary: Upload evidence of the pharmacy's recruitment process AND a signed contract of one current staff member.

evidenceExamples.text: A written recruitment process.
A signed employment contract for one current staff member.

requirements.title: Pharmacy student placements
requirements.sourceVersion: QCPP remote assessment portal — surveillance round, printed 20 Oct 2026
requirements.wording: Provide details of whether students undertake placement in your pharmacy. If yes, provide a copy of the signed agreement.
requirements.summary: Answer YES or NO: does the pharmacy have students on placement? If YES, upload the placement agreement.

evidenceExamples.text: A YES/NO answer about students on placement.
A signed placement agreement (only if students are placed).
